notes.title: Metal Mind : Major Update
notes.content:
Dear Players.

Thank you for your continued support and interest. We are proud to announce the launch of a major update to Metal Mind, which will bring you a brand new gaming experience.

[list]
[*] Made a complete out-of-bureau enhancemen system.[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35950728/abc2122e46a3be20428398c4d9d01868945423ad.gif[/img]
[*] Stripped the style system and the out-of-bounds enhancement system.
[*] Optimized the level map of the game and shortened the experience time to 35 minutes.
[*] Bomb traps can be re-generated.
[*] Created new laser traps.
[*] Merged the mechanics of superheat and overheat, differentiated the genre features and fixed the related text.
[*] Adjusted equipment properties for different genres.
[*] Adjusted weapon related values, especially for overheat and non-overheat weapons. Overheat weapons have longer overheat duration and non-overheat weapons have longer cooldown.
[*] Overload maneuver has a longer invincibility frame.
[*] Added sound effects that were previously missing.
[*] Adjusted the drop probability of dungeon weapons.
[*] Added new weapon shooting effects.
[*] Passes no longer inherit progression modifications.
[*] Adjusted the path finding AI of enemies
[*] Added startup effects to Ninja Style.
[*] Non-combat time no longer increases movement speed.
[*] Closed the entrance to other difficulties.
[/list]

Finally, we are looking forward to your feedback and suggestions for this update, if you have any questions or suggestions, please feel free to contact us.

Thank you again for your support and love of Metal Mind, and we will continue to work hard to bring you an even better gaming experience. Thank you!

notes.title: Dev Log 20230223
notes.content:
Thanks to your support, we're about to make a major update! Expected in early March.
1. Reinforcement system for the lobby
Function Introduction.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35950728/abc2122e46a3be20428398c4d9d01868945423ad.gif[/img]
[list]
[*] Warfare System - Strengthen the body through attributes, for example, directly increase attack power, shooting speed, movement speed, etc., total 22 skills.
[*] Room System - Strengthen the body through event rooms, such as giving the player fire support in the combat event room, increasing the benefit of the event room, etc. 14 skills in total.
[*] Reset System - Strengthen the body by death, for example, keep 3 Advanced Enhancement after death, increase attribute gain after death, etc. Total 11 skills.
[/list]

2. Level adjustment
Adjustment of enemy configuration experience in different maps.
[list]
[*] The configuration type of monsters in the small map is mostly light enemies, and the level is easier
[*] The configuration type of monsters in the medium map is more tank and charge heavy enemies, and there are more traps in the level.
[*] The monster configuration of the large map is more offensive and defensive enemies, and the level is more complicated.
[/list]

We are about to remove the design that keeps all Advanced Enhancement after passing the game.

Based on our testing, the new system will significantly change the game experience, so mark the next update as a major update.

notes.title: Dev Log: New Content Preview
notes.content:
Dear players,
Thank you all for your support! We are constantly working on new content and aim to create a better gaming experience. We are currently working on some surprises that we hope to share with you in the near future.
We value the player feedback and have made the following adjustments to the game (the game is still under development and the content is not final):

[h3]Combat[/h3]
[olist]
[*] We've adjusted the forced cooldown of weapons, which allows you to shoot more freely.
[*] When your weapon overheats, you can use the heat venting feature.
[*] New heat monitoring UI - you can control weapon heat more accurately.
[*] Optimize the sounds to make the sound effects more complex.
[/olist]

[h3]Mecha styles[/h3]
We created exclusive paint jobs for bodies. More mecha styles for mecha enthusiasts~
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35950728/9e39e08b3ac8154319ec9f5cd4d77a71f0d70ce5.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35950728/12b14a82b99837fc0d6a146bb63cf0b8b9c45226.jpg[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35950728/199751675ab1fdfe5f2a87e9c817e178ee52c340.png[/img]

[h3]Builds[/h3]
Added more build-specific skills and skills that improve base modifications.
For example:
The[b] cooldown build[/b] can significantly increase various basic attributes by increasing cooling frequency.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35950728/7dec4669ab1bf78f0a6aac68fc3a6e1883c0bf00.gif[/img]
It is also possible to freeze the enemy with an ice attack using the cooldown effect.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35950728/26cfeaeb37be27fbaa838e7092a85471ee7d32a2.gif[/img]

The [b]weapon heat build[/b] can deal critical hits using overheat effects.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35950728/b71f80508a653832ea607131e798a3632d19f47b.gif[/img]
It can also burn enemies using the "flamethrower" and stack "ignite" debuff.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35950728/002ad0e033453fb90d1aa463b2eada7a9c80c80f.gif[/img]

The [b]electro build[/b] can control, pull, and hit groups of enemies using "high voltage".
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35950728/fee91868694b3407aaf044384a9fc4b487b5e588.gif[/img]
You can also use a variety of unique skills frequently.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35950728/5f508a90fed28b8e461b30c2c64c934e9a68f456.gif[/img]

[h3]Event Room[/h3]
Added more events. The events are no longer limited to the mecha theme.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35950728/4327a92a5b00edebcc8f996cc8429bec8451d5c7.gif[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35950728/f6758eadb295a2148e2ac37ddaf6897a6ce8f423.gif[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35950728/c9d860d728126dbb93bbac01e16866911841aeb3.gif[/img]

[h3]New peripheral modification system[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35950728/08fea7748e9bdd015f0e2b0a2e9e1f09ba621bb8.png[/img]

In addition, we have been optimizing the game performance, aiming to provide you with a smoother gaming experience.
We greatly value the feedback from our players. If you have any suggestions or feedback, feel free to contact us. We will read each and every one of them and try our best to improve the game.
Thanks again for your support. We look forward to having a great time with you all!

Salute,
WHIRLLAXY STUDIOS

notes.title: Dev Letter & Update Plan
notes.content:
Hello Gamers!

It's been two weeks since the release of Metal Mind. Before we get started today, a huge [b]THANK YOU[/b] from us to every one of you that have chosen and played our game - it's an exhilarating experience watching you enjoy, discuss, and share your opinion and kind suggestions with us. As a small independent team, your encouragement and comments really cheered us on. Of course, problems also showed up and we have read each and every one of your feedbacks and have already included them in our future update plan, which is the major content of today's announcement.

For some urgent bugs, we have published a bunch of small updates in the past two weeks. However, some major issues cannot be fully solved by just small updates, so we need MORE time. But don't worry. It does not mean we don't care or we just quit ([b]definitely NOT![/b]). On the contrary, we have already included some major updates concerning most players' demand in our roadmap and relevant development and optimization work has been in full swing.

Today we will share with you the update plan for the next few months.

[h3]Month 1[/h3]
1. [b]You can save the game![/b] You will be able to restart the level you left last time or load the game save in the lobby.
2. You can get a lower price for basic enhancements and the number of currencies you obtain from finishing a game will be adjusted.
3. [b]Cloud saves[/b] will finally be here! Sorry if it is too late, but we are trying to make it up.
4. [b]Achievement system[/b] can be expected. An estimated number of 30 Steam achievements will be ready for you to challenge and unlock. Enjoy yourselves!
5. [b]Customizable controls[/b] will make it possible for you to make your own combat style!

[h3]Month 2[/h3]
1. [b]Level 1 map will be remade[/b] to reduce the size of the map and optimize the corners, which definitely will guarantee a faster game pace [strike](or faster death)[/strike].
2. To [b]improve the hit feedback[/b] to make the combat more exciting.
3. To [b]make the transformations more convenient[/b]. The development of a new armory system may take longer with many uncertainties, but what is sure is you need not get back to the first room to get the transformations assembled.

[h3]Long-term Plan[/h3]
1. Redesign the build experience
2. Enlarge the weapon and equipment pool
3. Optimize the drop of advanced enhancements

Priority is given to ensure the Month 1 & 2 update plan achieved. At the same time, we will keep reading your feedbacks, which is inspiring as well as pushing us to do better. We hope the "transformed" Metal Mind will give you a different game experience.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35950728/e795e3985f4105234850aeac73373cd7f94aeed9.png[/img]

notes.title: 【APOLOGY】The Latest Announcement About the Controller Issue
notes.content:
Regarding the poor controller control performance that our players have reported in the past few days, we are sincerely sorry and have already started making changes as soon as possible, hoping to improve the game experience. However, the problem is more complicated and intractable than we expected, so we may need more time to completely solve this problem. For the time, we still cannot provide a perfect controller experience. We will report our progress truthfully to everyone. Any suggestions and solutions are welcome. 

[u]Currently known controller problems[/u]: PS series controllers cannot be used, and Xbox controllers may fail to fire and release engine skills in different scenarios and computer configurations.  It is currently inferred that it is due to the difference in the recognition of the controller buttons under different drivers.

[u]Temporary solution[/u]: Players using controllers need to [b]enable controller support first in the game settings menu[/b]! ! ! If the controller support is turned on in the game settings menu and you can enter the game level, the firing and engine skill release are normal, then the controller can be used normally.

[u]Optimization priority[/u]: Priority is given to handling the issue of possible controller failure with different drivers, and adding the dynamic switching function of the controller and the keyboard/mouse.

As a producer, I feel the same as everyone's anger and helplessness during the experience, and it's even more tormented. We will fully devote ourselves to fixing the controller problem, and strive to give players who continue to pay attention to our "Metal Mind" a better gaming experience.

notes.title: Metal Mind Launch Date Announcement & FAQ
notes.content:
Hello Gamers,

Long time no see.

It's finally time - we are super excited to announce that we are launching Metal Mind on Steam on [b]April 25th 00:00 (PDT)[/b]. As always, I really appreciate the attention and encouragement that all of you have generously given to us. During the past few months, we have been buried in developing and polishing the whole game experience, leaving us no time to connect with you so often. Great news is we have completed most of the work needed before launch and in the nest period, we will pour more of our efforts into listening to the gamers' views and continously updating our game to make it better. If you have anything to say, please leave it in the comments below, or [url=https://discord.gg/w6dQ4vrswf][b]join our Discord channel [/b][/url]to talk with me directly!

Here are quick answers to frequently asked questions about Metal Mind recently. More information will be delivered in the next few days.

[b]First, a brief introduction of our team...[/b]
This is Joash and his team, Whirllaxy Studio, an all-platform game studio from China. Since college graduation, I have been engaged in the art design of console & PC games, and have participated in the development of many AAA games. 
As the producer of Metal Mind, I really appreciate all the support I got from the players, and every member from  Whirllxy Studio. You are the source of my power.
I graduated high school with two wishes: first, to work on the Final Fantasy series; Second, to be a game producer. Now both wishes have come true! Shall I have a new one? I hope more like-minded people can join us to create unique and cool game experience for all players!

[b]And Metal Mind is a game about...[/b]
Metal Mind is a top-down shooting game that combines Mecha transformations and Roguelite. In Metal Mind, you can assemble your own Mecha with different body parts and thrilling weapons, which may make your little AI robot a monstorus battle machine! Kill the bosses and fight for freedom!

[b]So, why Metal Mind?[/b]
"Mecha is men's romance."
and..."We Love Titanfall!"
Metal Mind is a decision made by the Collective Intelligence of our team, and I am very grateful to my teammates for providing me with many thoughts and ideas.
[b]Compared with the demo version, what's new can we expect in the official launch version?[/b]
The official launch version has a full 4 levels, 9 bosses and more weapons.

[b]What languages does Metal Mind support?[/b]
Currently, Metal Mind supports Simplified Chinese, English, and Japanese. We are really sorry if your primary language isn't in the list. We will try to cover more languages in future updates!

[b]Where can I get Metal Mind?[/b]
Metal Mind is only available on Steam for NOW. More platforms support is under consideration. If you are users of other game platforms, you can look forward to it!

[b]Does Metal Mind have controller support?[/b]
Yes! The game should automatically work with PS4, Xbox, other similar controllers. If you run into issues, please submit your feedback via Discord or bug report sheet.

[b]Does Metal Mind have a discount in the first few days?[/b]
Yes! We will have 15% discount lasting for two weeks during launch time. Do not miss it if you are interested in Metal MInd.

That is the end of this announcement. Thanks for your reading!

notes.title: Metal Mind is coming to E3 2021!
notes.content:
It is with excitement and tension that we announce: Metal Mind will be exhibiting at E3 2021!

We've always been a small and indie team, playing and making games in Shanghai, China.

Now we will join with our publisher Yooreka Studio at E3 2021, where we will begin this grand adventure together.

We'll be featuring a trailer to share the gameplay and fun of Metal Mind with players around the world.

Our producer will also make his first appearance, introducing the game in a clip shot from his own home. We hope you enjoy it!

You might not know, but you can probably imagine -- Our robot has braved the dungeons countless times, day after day, in order to see you.

We hope that this time, at E3 2021, we can finally meet.
